map.FIM 功能独立性评定总分计算器 使用指南: FIM Independence Measure Total Score Calculator Guide
map.按 FIM 的 18 个项目（运动 13 项 + 认知 5 项）逐项选择 1–7: Choose a 1-7 score for each of the 18 FIM items (13 motor + 5 cognitive), then sum motor /91, cognitive /35 and total /126 and assign one of 8 independence grades. This page only sums and grades; it does not weight items or predict discharge scores.
map.FIM 共 18 项：运动 13 项（自理、括约肌控制、转移、行走）合计 13–: FIM has 18 items: 13 motor items (self-care, sphincter control, transfers, walking) totaling 13-91, and 5 cognitive items (communication, social cognition) totaling 5-35, for a total of 18-126. Each item is scored 1-7: 7 complete independence, 6 modified independence, 5 supervision/setup, 4 minimal assistance, 3 moderate assistance, 2 maximal assistance, 1 complete dependence.
map.本页只做 18 项求和与分级: This page only sums the 18 items and assigns a grade
map.，不加权、不推断病因、不预测出院分数。: , without weighting items, inferring causes or predicting discharge scores.
map.入院时记录基线总分与运动/认知分项，作为后续复评的参照。: Record the baseline total and motor/cognitive subtotals on admission as a reference for later re-assessment.
map.出院前再次评分，人工对比两次记录的变化（本页不算差值）。: Re-score before discharge and compare the two records manually (this page does not compute differences).
map.随访时重复评分，保存多次记录便于回溯。: Repeat the score during follow-up and keep multiple records for review.
map.：运动 13×4 = 52/91，认知 5×4 = 20/35，总分 72/12: : motor 13x4 = 52/91, cognitive 5x4 = 20/35, total 72/126, which falls in the 72-89 mild dependence band.
map.本工具纯前端运行，输入内容不上传服务器。FIM 须由受训康复团队按统一操作规范评: This tool runs entirely in the front end and does not upload inputs. FIM must be rated by a trained rehabilitation team using standard procedures; self- or family-entered scores are for record keeping only. The grading thresholds serve records and team communication,
map.。如需要比较入院与出院变化，请分别记录两次评分后人工计算差值。: . To compare admission and discharge, record both scores and compute the difference manually.
map.本页会计算入院到出院的差值吗？: Does this page compute the admission-to-discharge difference?
map.不会。本页只做单次 18 项求和与分级；多次评分可保存到记录中，但差值、FIM: No. This page only sums and grades a single assessment. Multiple scores can be saved, but differences, FIM efficiency and FIM gain must be computed manually or with another tool.
map.为什么总分相同也要看运动/认知分项？: Why check motor and cognitive subtotals when the total is the same?
map.运动与认知分量表反映不同功能领域，相同总分下认知分低往往提示不同的康复需求与预后: The motor and cognitive subscales cover different functional areas; with the same total, a lower cognitive score often points to different rehabilitation needs and prognosis. The page shows motor /91 and cognitive /35 separately for item-level interpretation.
